error[ZC-E0809]: a certificate is malformed or outside the bounds
  cause  node2's certificate was refused: its subjectAltName is not exactly one
         name of the right shape (field: subjectAltName)
  fix    check that both sides use this cluster's CA or the pinned anchor (docs/mtls.md)
